import sys,json,csv,io,base64,plistlib,struct
sys.path.insert(0,'submission');sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
from campaign import audit
from common import parse_json
HDR=('type','id','revision','published','op','lease','event','probe','target','responder','result','service','attempt','payload')
def frame(d,fmt):b=plistlib.dumps(d,fmt=fmt);return struct.pack('>I',len(b))+b
def syncp(v1,v2,fmt):return frame({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':v1},fmt)+frame({'Key':'ProductName','Request':'GetValue','Value':v2},fmt)
def run(payloads):
 s=io.StringIO(newline='');w=csv.writer(s,lineterminator='\n');w.writerow(HDR)
 w.writerow(['icmp','i','0','1','put','h','1','0/i1','2001:db8::1','2001:db8::1','echo','','',''])
 for k,p in enumerate(payloads):w.writerow(['app',f'a{k}','0','1','put','h','1','','2001:db8::1','','open','y','0',base64.b64encode(p).decode()])
 cap={'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(s.getvalue().encode()).decode()]}
 job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':[{'id':'h','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':0,'end':10,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}],'services':[{'id':'y','kind':'sync'}],'queries':[5],'captures':[cap],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
 out=audit(parse_json(json.dumps(job).encode()));return out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]
print('same xml/bin',run([syncp('1','D',plistlib.FMT_XML),syncp('1','D',plistlib.FMT_BINARY)]))
print('diff',run([syncp('1','D',plistlib.FMT_XML),syncp('1','E',plistlib.FMT_XML)]))
EOF
